shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' AGENTS.md && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' | sort | sed -n '1,240p' && sed -n '1,240p' package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "find app -type f -maxdepth 5 -print -exec sh -c 'echo \"FILE: "'$1"; sed -n "1,260p" "$1"'"' _ {} \\; && printf '\\nLIB\\n' && sed -n '1,300p' lib/data.ts && printf '\\nDOC FILES\\n' && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md && sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md && sed -n '1,360p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts && git status --short && git log -5 --oneline"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"granular|Suspense|navigation|fallback|static shell\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md | sed -n '1,180p' && sed -n '120,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md && rg -n \"connection\\(|Cache Components|Suspense\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | sed -n '1,240p' && git diff -- app lib next.config.ts package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && git show HEAD:app/product/page.tsx && git show HEAD:lib/data.ts && git show HEAD:next.config.ts && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json package.json next.config.ts && git diff --stat'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '470,570p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -type f | rg 'partial|cache-components|link' | sort | sed -n '1,160p' && rg -n \"partialPrefetching|cacheComponents\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/prefetching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,160p' && rg -l \"Premium Widget\" .next/server/app .next/server/chunks 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,80p' && for f in "'$(rg -l "Premium Widget" .next/server/app 2>/dev/null | head -5); do echo "$f"; rg -o "Premium Widget|Loading inventory|[0-9]+ in stock|Price: '"\\\\"'$[0-9.]+" "$f" | head -20; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o 'Premium Widget|Loading inventory|[0-9]+ in stock|Price: \\"'$[0-9.]+'"' .next/server/app/product.html .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc | sed -n '1,100p' && sed -n '1,60p' .next/server/app/product.html"
